title: Canon of Scripture
definition: The Canon of Scripture is the complete collection of God-given biblical books received by God’s people as authoritative Scripture.
summary: The Canon of Scripture is the complete collection of God-given biblical books received by God’s people as authoritative Scripture.
christFocus: Jesus and His apostles treated the Scriptures as God’s authoritative Word, and the completed biblical canon bears faithful witness to Christ and His Gospel.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The canon matters because God’s people need to know what Scripture is. The Bible is not an open-ended collection that can be reshaped by every generation. God gave His Word, and His people received the writings that bore His authority.

The canon protects the Church from adding human ideas to Scripture or removing parts of God’s witness. It gives believers a defined Bible to read, teach, translate, memorize, and obey. God’s people are not left to build doctrine from rumors, private revelations, or spiritual trends.

The whole canon points to Christ. The Law, Prophets, Writings, Gospels, apostolic teaching, and final hope of Scripture unite around God’s saving work through Jesus. The canon gives the Church the complete written witness needed for Gospel faithfulness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People can be confused by claims of lost books, secret writings, or new revelations that supposedly change Christian faith. The canon helps believers rest in the Word God has given rather than chasing hidden authorities.

This doctrine also matters for discipleship because a clear Bible gives a clear foundation. Believers do not need to wonder which voice carries God’s authority.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive the Bible as the complete written Word God has given for His people. Do not build your faith on secret claims or spiritual novelties; read the Scriptures God has preserved and ask the Holy Spirit to lead you to Christ through them.
